reviews.title: Beautiful high-performance cooling!
reviews.comment: Purchased two of these 140mm SL-INF white reverse blade fans (14RSLIN1W) to use as a front intake in my white O11 Dynamic Evo build. I'm using all SL-INF fans for the infinity mirror effect but I wanted to have the unobstructed view of the infinity mirror (no fan cage) visible from the inside of the case through the side panel, so some reverse blade SL-INFs were required for proper airflow configuration while maintaining the infinity mirror effect. These are excellent fans, being 140mm they move a good amount of air and do so quietly. They look fantastic as well – I know Lian Li has some newer UNI Fans available but I'm good with these. They're a bit pricey compared to alternatives but they're worth it to me. Worth noting that the fans themselves only come with a split/universal cable for PWM and ARGB. If you want to plug these into an SL-INF uni fan controller, you will need the cables that came with the controller instead. Worked for me since I was replacing 3x 120mm "normal" blade SL-INFs with 2x 140mm reverse blades, I just reused the existing fan cables. Purchased through 3rd party "QuickDealStore" - no issues whatsoever, these were priced well, I got the exact item(s) I ordered, and they shipped and arrived sooner than expected. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.title: Not as brite as newer models
reviews.comment: I put 3 of these and a hub in the bottom of a 011 dynamic, good quality, no issues with software, they are not as brite as the led fans and the infinity effect on the sides is minimal. These fans are like unicorns though, A white reverse 140mm uni, if you find them you better buy them. Im also not experiencing any of the software issues with L connect that others have. But im using a usb hub with sata power. Lconnect is using minimal cpu..mabey 1.5% Overaíll the quality is very good, if you can find them. If you combine tl and sa fans with 2 hubs you will need a usb hub and all of your sata connections.
